A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cross-protection is a phenomenon that can occur in experimentally induced asthma, but the mechanism is not fully elucidated.
cross-protection can be obtained using RIT with allergens that are not completely matched to the sensitizing or inducing allergens.
RIT with a partial repertoire of a sensitizing allergen can induce cross-protection and modulate aberrant immune response in cats with experimentally-induced asthma.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RIT using a partial repertoire of the sensitizing allergen may be an effective treatment in cats with asthma.
